nuggets.text: The Demon Deacons and Purdue are the only two FBS teams that wear Old Gold and Black.
Gio Lopez is the first Demon Deacons QB since Sam Hartman in 2021 to throw for 350 yards and three TDs without a pick.
Demon Deacons QB Gio Lopez led South Alabama to the first bowl win in its program history.
Ty Clark III ran for 105 yards on just seven carries in the Demon Deacons' opener against Akron.
Carlos Hernandez broke a tackle and went 78 yards for a touchdown in the Demon Deacons' opener against Akron.
Demon Deacons coach Jake Dickert won nine games in 2025, his first season, capped by a Duke's Mayo Bowl win.
The Demon Deacon name came from a 1923 newspaper editor who praised Wake Forest's 'devilish' play.
The Demon Deacon mascot rides onto the field on a motorcycle at many Wake Forest home games.
The Demon Deacons played the first college football game in North Carolina, beating UNC 6-4 in 1888.
The Demon Deacons and Purdue meet for the first time since Sept. 13, 2003, a 16-10 Boilermakers win.
